description: Check whether diagram source (Mermaid, PlantUML, C4-PlantUML, Graphviz/DOT, D2, Structurizr, BPMN, Excalidraw) is valid, without returning an image. Returns { valid, errors: [{ line?, message }] }. Use it to check syntax you are unsure of before rendering or before handing diagram code to the user. Call list_formats for a valid example of each format.

format.description: Diagram language. One of: mermaid, plantuml, c4plantuml, graphviz, d2, structurizr, bpmn, excalidraw, dot ("dot" is an alias for graphviz).

source.description: The diagram source text, exactly as it would appear in a file of that format.

name: validate_diagram
title: Validate diagram
